brief: Holds Ring source as a code graph: classes with their parent, methods and a name-based graph of the calls between them.
detail: Its parser reads the Ring source itself: class headers with a single parent, def lines, and the calls in method bodies, found as an identifier before an open parenthesis once string literals and comments are stripped. A call is an edge only when some class defines a method of that name, so the graph is name-based and honest about it. DeadCode is scoped to private helpers that nothing references, and CyclicCalls to two methods of one class that call each other, the signals a name-based graph can assert without guessing. The query surface of the family (classes, owners, ancestry, impact, cascade) is inherited from stzCodeGraph. Build one from a folder with new stzRingCodeGraph(path) or from text with StzRingCodeGraphFromSource.
receiver: o1 = StzRingCodeGraphFromSource("class Animal" + nl + "def Speak()" + nl + "return This._Sound()" + nl + "def _Sound()" + nl + "return 1" + nl + "def _Unused()" + nl + "return 2" + nl + "class Dog from Animal" + nl + "def Fetch()" + nl + "return This.Speak()" + nl)
